title: WELCOME TO OSU: INTERNATIONAL FIRST YEAR EXPERIENCE
description: A university integration class specifically designed for new students at Oregon State University.  Explore topics such as academic integrity, working with academic advisors, U.S. academic culture, navigating campus resources, communicating with professors, and integrating into the campus community.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment is limited to INTO OSU GE/AE/Pathways level students.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
